description: This source file defines the ArticlesController class, which manages HTTP endpoints related to articles, such as listing, retrieving, creating, editing, and deleting articles in a web API project.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller handling CRUD and listing operations for articles, using dependency-injected IMediator for mediating commands and queries.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing articles with optional filters such as tag, author, favorited, limit, and offset.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests for fetching the user's personalized article feed with optional filters.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for fetching a single article identified by its slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to edit an existing article identified by its slug, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article identified by its slug, requiring authorization.
